title: Rounding work runtime bound
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and let $s\ge1$ be an integer Fourier $1$-norm bound. Put $\varepsilon=a/b$ and $R=(n+1)(s+1)/\varepsilon$. The exact sparse spectrum rounding work for these parameters is at most $2^{170}R^{100}$.
